statement: Add deterministic ReleasePreparation and ReleaseVerification so DevRelay can materialize and prove an exact release candidate after accepted environment readiness without taking publication, deployment, or promotion authority.
objectives: Prepare one exact source and installable-library release candidate from approved integrated project state.
Verify packaging, documentation, evidence sealing, supported-host readiness, and promotion prerequisites.
Keep release tooling provider-neutral, explicitly granted, checkpointed, replayable, and replaceable.
Preserve exact redacted release evidence and traceability without rebuilding or substituting verified bytes.
Operate through ChatGPT/Codex Desktop on Windows as the release-defining host.
constraints: Core owns routing, validation, gates, progression, checkpointing, and traceability authority.
EnvironmentPreparation readiness is a mandatory pre-execution dependency.
Release preparation cannot publish, deploy, promote, or mutate protected main.
Public npm publication, one-click Desktop installation, hosted operation, and non-Windows support remain excluded.
Architecture and implementation remain blocked until adaptive requirements closure reaches 0.99.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact approved source state and configuration determine one reproducible release candidate identity.
Every required release verification has exact passing evidence or an approved not-applicable disposition.
Stale inputs, missing readiness, failed checks, or substituted candidate bytes block progression.
Exact checkpoint replay performs no duplicate release effects and returns byte-identical results.
A clean Windows Desktop source checkout can prepare and verify the installable candidate end to end.
assumptions: The 0.10.0-rc.3 publication and its exact assets are immutable historical evidence.
Routine in-scope gates and implementation changes have standing owner approval.
Unresolved product intent, external authority, and trust-boundary choices require explicit clarification.
